thread:
lee_sales: Heads-up: Mercantile wants us to replace CompetitorX for billing chat. They asked for a 7-day POC, pricing comparison, and answers to their security questionnaire. Can we cover behavior parity and quick steps?
nina_se: We can do a compatibility gateway that rewrites their session_id and response keys. Biggest risks: system message injection and token-count differences.
cameron_eng: Implementation notes: gateway maps session_id -> conversation_id, rewrites response fields to match CompetitorX shape, and optionally strips auto-injected system role. Extra latency ~12ms p95.
lee_sales: Pricing: they want per-conversation estimate vs CompetitorX. Any ballpark?
nina_se: Rough estimate: our average tokens per billing convo = 620 tokens. If CompetitorX counts fewer due to compressed metadata, assume ~0.95x. Recommend reserved capacity discount for predictable cost.
taylor_sec: Security checklist: SOC2 SNIPPET ready, subprocessor list available, KMS integration supported, customer-managed key possible. Need Mercantile security contact for questionnaire file.
lee_sales: Can we provide a minimal smoke curl for their engineers to test and a mapping example for responses?
cameron_eng: Yes. Example request: POST /v1/compat with session_id and messages. Example response mapping: our "conversation_id" -> expected "id", "generated_text" -> expected "text", and include token counts. We'll provide a small adapter script too.
nina_se: I'll run a 50-prompt eval they care about and produce delta metrics (accuracy diffs, token delta, latency). Need their canonical prompts and expected outputs.
taylor_sec: Also flag: if they require on-prem or VPC-only deployment, lead time is longer (6-10 weeks). If they accept staging in our dedicated environment, POC can start within 48h after allowlist.
lee_sales: I'll ask Mercantile for the prompt set, security contact, and whether they need KMS binding. Targeting start by Monday. Thanks all :raised_hands:
